Calindvale Gardens Spriggans are tree spirits that vaguely resemble mortal women. They are hostile, and difficult to kill due to their ability to heal themselves and summon allies to their aid. Spriggans can be found in a variety of wooded places. In Reaper's March, they're primarily found next to tall trees near places bordering the edge of the map, such as Fort Grimwatch, Greenhill, and Willowgrove. Starting with Ascending Tide, some newer spriggan variants walk on two legs. These spriggans are rigged using the Sylvan Spriggan polymorph, often wield weapons, and are classified as NPCs instead of creatures.
